winner.text: Replace pointwise BCE with within-user RankNet pairwise loss while retaining the current user, video, and request-context inputs, optimizer family, and canonical displayed-candidate evaluation.
winner.rationale: The current scorer reaches GAUC 0.6689 and nDCG@5 0.5370, but its pointwise objective is not directly aligned with within-user ordering. Pairwise training is a focused objective ablation with plausible GAUC upside.
winner.exact_ablation: Change only the training objective from row-wise BCE to within-user RankNet loss using positive-negative pairs from the same intact user candidate group; keep features, model capacity, optimizer, sampling limits, and evaluation unchanged.

expected_effect.GAUC: Expected small positive gain of +0.001 to +0.006 because the loss directly optimizes positive-over-negative ordering within users.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: Expected flat to modestly positive change of -0.001 to +0.004; top-five gains depend on whether sampled pairs include high-scoring negatives.

selection_rationale: Select the within-user RankNet pairwise loss ablation. It is the Consultant's top-ranked candidate and directly aligns training with the official within-user GAUC objective while preserving all inputs, model capacity, optimizer, candidate groups, and evaluation. It offers the strongest expected primary gain among the reliable candidates (+0.0025), with moderate confidence (6), low leakage risk, and only medium runtime risk. Compared with listwise or history-based alternatives, it is narrower and more dependable; compared with user-normalized BCE, it has higher expected upside while retaining a clean, interpretable objective-only change.
